pathAssistantSteps.info:
Upload the collected Reinsurer Signed Slip to the Policy record


Issue the Credit Note, Debit Note, or Credit/Debit CN as applicable

Confirm Panel

  • Finalize and confirm the participating reinsurers

Receive Cedant Closing Slip

  • Obtain the Cedant’s closing slip and upload the document

Send Binding Email (RI Closing Slip)

  • Send the binding email to reinsurers with the RI Closing Slip attached

Receive Bound Email

  • Receive Bound email from reinsurers
  • Record the binding date

Send Submission Email to Reinsurers

  • Send the submission email to selected reinsurers
  • Attach the RI Offer Slip

Receive Quotations via Email

  • Collect quotation responses from reinsurers by email
  • Review the received quotations for comparison

Receive and Upload the Cedant Offer Slip

  • Obtain the Cedant’s offer slip from the client
  • Verify the contents and upload the document

Enter Underwriting Information

  • Input the underwriting information based on the received offer slip
  • Ensure all key details (such as Period, LOB, Transaction Type) are accurately recorded

​Issue the RI Offer Slip

  • Prepare and issue the the Reinsurance Offer Slip
  • Review for accuracy and completeness before issuing the RI Offer Slip
